reason: A Zotero-to-Obsidian research knowledge-management plugin that synchronizes literature, processes PDFs and metadata with external services, compiles searchable notes and indexes, and provides agent retrieval with literature citations.

summaries.zh: 将 Zotero 文献库同步并处理为可检索的 Obsidian 知识库，生成结构化笔记、索引和带文献引用的 Agent 检索结果。
summaries.en: Syncs a Zotero library into a searchable Obsidian knowledge base with processed documents, structured notes, indexes, and agent retrieval with literature citations.

capabilities: Reads Zotero metadata from a local SQLite database or Zotero Web API
Synchronizes and writes literature notes, indexes, links, and archives to an Obsidian vault
Uploads PDFs to MinerU for parsing
Sends document content to DeepSeek for structured note generation and topic reviews
Exposes agent tools for searching, synchronizing, parsing, and archiving research content
